## Change

Describe the user-visible change and why it helps.

## Validation

- [ ] `./Scripts/test.sh` passes
- [ ] `./Scripts/package.sh` passes if build or packaging changed
- [ ] UI screenshots are regenerated if their appearance changed
- [ ] Live Spotify checks are described separately from mocked tests
- [ ] README and capability matrix reflect any compatibility or feature change
- [ ] No account data, tokens, callbacks, generated builds, or signing credentials are committed
